_doc.purpose: Deterministic 'who buffs this hero' partner suggestions. Consumed by scripts/suggest-comps.mjs. NEVER auto-writes to hero files - produces evidence-backed candidates for human review.
_doc.model: Directional. This hero's NEEDS = its stat drivers (reused from virtueRules.json via detectDrivers). A partner's CONTRIBUTION = only its tags in contributionCategories (team support + enemy debuff that the whole team benefits from). A partner is a candidate only when it has a tag this hero needs. Rank by number of needs filled, tie-break by overall rating. ADD-only.
_doc.whySafe: No invented relationships. Partner appears because it literally carries tag X (already human-curated in its synergies) and this hero literally needs X (driver-detected). The matched tags are the evidence.
_doc.excluded: A partner's SELF_BUFFS / PLAYSTYLE / UTILITY tags never count - they help only the partner, not this hero.
